parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: **50**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token for the next query in a paged query.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the route learning relationship. Valid values:
- **Active**: active.
- **Enabling**: being enabled.
- **Disabling**: being disabled.

parameters.name: TransitRouterAttachmentResourceType
parameters.description:
The network instance type. Valid values:

- **VPC**: virtual private cloud (VPC) instance.
- **VBR**: virtual border router (VBR) instance.
- **TR**: transit router instance.
- **VPN**: VPN connection.

parameters.name: TransitRouterRouteTableId
parameters.description: The ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router route table.
